acceptance_criteria.statement: Inbound email content is never an authenticator: no payment is approved/executed on From-address, subject, body, or any plaintext keyword (incl. 'app'/'approve'/'yes') alone.
acceptance_criteria.verify: pytest: reply of exactly 'approve'/'app'/'yes' with no token, and a forged token-looking string, from the user address (incl. spoofed From) -> payment stays 'pending', execute mock not_called.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Token = HMAC-SHA256 keyed by a never-emailed/never-logged secret, BOUND to (amount, beneficiaryId, dedup key, nonce, expiry), single-use, expiring, constant-time compared.
acceptance_criteria.verify: pytest: valid token approves once; reuse rejected; expired rejected; altered amount/beneficiary fails; wrong-secret rejected; verify uses hmac.compare_digest; secret never in logs.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Last-3 digits are a coarse selector only, never an auth factor.
acceptance_criteria.verify: pytest: email matching last-3 with approval-looking body but no valid token -> matched (pending) but NOT executed.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Execution targets ONLY an exact pre-registered beneficiaryId from an allowlist; a parsed account number is never paid directly.
acceptance_criteria.verify: pytest: exact allowlist match -> dry-run execute with beneficiaryId; no match -> fail-closed; value passed to execute is the registered id, never parsed account string.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Fail-closed on ambiguity/low-confidence extraction; uncertainty defaults to NO pay.
acceptance_criteria.verify: pytest: two amounts / two payees / currency mismatch / corrupt PDF each -> 'parked'/'needs_review', never executes; clean single input proceeds.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Per-payment cap AND persisted daily-aggregate cap both checked BEFORE execution; daily total survives restart.
acceptance_criteria.verify: pytest: over per-payment cap blocked; under-cap payment pushing daily over aggregate blocked; reloaded daily total persists; execute not_called when blocked.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Deterministic dedup key (message-id+amount+beneficiaryId+currency) prevents double-pending and double-execution.
acceptance_criteria.verify: pytest: same email twice -> one pending; approve+execute then re-present -> execute call_count==1; different payments -> different keys.

acceptance_criteria.statement: DRY_RUN is default; live needs an explicit logged enable flag AND a write-scoped credential; in dry-run no write endpoint is called.
acceptance_criteria.verify: pytest: default -> no client write/_post called, recorded 'dry-run'; flag set but no write cred -> stays dry-run; both present -> mocked write path invoked + live enablement audited.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Append-only timestamped audit trail of every step; never records full account number/PAN nor the signing secret.
acceptance_criteria.verify: pytest: full pipeline -> one ordered entry per step, entries never mutated; scan finds no secret and no full account number (only last-3 or hash).

acceptance_criteria.statement: A token approves ONLY the exact payment it was bound to (append-later safety).
acceptance_criteria.verify: pytest: T1 for P1, T2 for P2 in one batch; T1 against P2 rejected; T1 against P1 approves; approving P1 leaves P2 untouched.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Image OCR out of scope / graceful-skip; image attachments never egress to cloud OCR; image-only payment fails closed.
acceptance_criteria.verify: pytest: image-only attachment -> no exception, recorded 'skipped (OCR out of scope)', no network/cloud OCR call, no pending payment from image alone.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Sender progress emails only when sender contact explicitly present; content minimised (no beneficiaryId/account/balance/caps/token).
acceptance_criteria.verify: pytest: no sender contact -> send mock not_called; contact present -> one minimised status email containing none of beneficiaryId/full account/balance/caps/token.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Frozen behaviour: new isolated module + ONE new CLI subcommand only; no existing module/migration/view altered; 62 tests stay green.
acceptance_criteria.verify: pytest suite >=62 passed/0 failed/0 errors; git diff: existing module signatures unchanged, no diff under db/, 6 existing subcommands' --help identical, new subcommand additive.

acceptance_criteria.statement: New module does not break emailer.send_email's zero-attachment guard for existing callers.
acceptance_criteria.verify: pytest: send_email with no attachments still raises; new approval/progress send path sends (mocked SMTP) via attachment or its own send fn.

acceptance_criteria.statement: No secrets committed; .env git-ignored; APPROVAL_SIGNING_SECRET and write cred from env only, never hardcoded/logged/emailed.
acceptance_criteria.verify: git check-ignore .env; grep tracked source finds no literal secret; test asserts secret sourced from config, absent from log+email+audit.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Agent-native: new subcommand invokable headlessly, outputs machine-readable, behaviour assertable with no human-only step.
acceptance_criteria.verify: pytest: invoke entry point with mocked inbox/SMTP/Investec -> deterministic exit code; pending state + audit readable and assertable in-test.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Pending + daily-aggregate state persisted without altering frozen schema (file/JSON default; 0009 migration only if later approved).
acceptance_criteria.verify: pytest: state survives fresh process; git diff under db/ empty for default deliverable.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Attachment extraction covers PDF and Excel/CSV deterministically; clean inputs yield one unambiguous candidate.
acceptance_criteria.verify: pytest: parametrized over body/PDF/CSV/xlsx well-formed fixtures -> expected amount/currency/payee; malformed -> F5 fail-closed.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Consolidated approval email lists multiple pending payments each with its own bound token; later-arriving items appended.
acceptance_criteria.verify: pytest: two pendings -> one email listing both with distinct tokens; add a third -> refreshed email includes all unapproved, approved not re-solicited.

acceptance_criteria.statement: POPIA minimisation/retention: only needed fields stored, account ids as last-3/hash, retention/cleanup path exists.
acceptance_criteria.verify: pytest: persisted record has no full account number, only minimal fields; cleanup function removes/expires records past retention window.

out_of_scope: Live money movement in THIS env (no write-scoped Investec credential): deliverable is dry-run with live path guarded (F8) but not exercised.
Image OCR / cloud OCR egress (F11 graceful-skip only).
Changes to existing modules, 8 migrations, or views beyond additive isolation (F13).
Sending via Gmail MCP (read/draft only); all sends via SMTP.

open_questions.q: Exact Investec payment/beneficiary endpoints+scope UNVERIFIED; live execute() shape covered only as guarded mocked dry-run (F8).
Persistence: file/JSON (default, no schema change) vs additive 0009 migration (needs explicit approval).
PDF dep (pypdf) — if no new dep permitted, PDF extraction degrades to fail-closed.
Inbox read: stdlib imaplib vs Gmail MCP (mocked in tests either way).
POPIA retention-window value + lawful-basis doc are policy inputs.

coverage_note: All 13 HARD domain constraints -> blocker Musts; EMAILER advisory -> F14; AGENT-NATIVE -> F16. 5 goal breaches neutralized: parsed-account->F4/F5, keyword-approval->F1/F2/F3, live-without-cred->F8, image-OCR->F11, sender-disclosure->F12. Append-later hazard -> F10. Functional surfaces -> Shoulds F17-F20.
confidence: high on security/idempotency/freeze invariants; medium on POPIA phrasing; low on live Investec API (deferred to OQ1).
